context: Asuka lectures on similarity and difference in art.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: art lecture; analytical vocabulary (同様/または/含め/最も) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 絵は、色または線で印象が決まります。
lines.en: A painting's impression is set by color or line.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 音楽も、同様なんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm curious engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、音楽も同様に、構成が大切です。
lines.en: Yes, in music too, structure matters similarly.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる名作には、共通点がありますか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 余白を含め、全体の調和が見事です。
lines.en: Including the blank space, the whole harmony is superb.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最も大切なのは、何でしょうか?
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最も大切なのは、作り手の心です。
lines.en: What matters most is the maker's heart.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 技術を含め、心が伝わるんですね。
lines.en: Including technique, the heart comes through.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
